dei.evidence: We are investing $300 million in our Diversity in Technology Initiative to achieve full representation of women and under-represented minorities at Intel by 2020

innovation.evidence: We believe technology must constantly evolve to make more things possible and all things easier, smarter, and more connected than ever before.

result.analyst_notes: Brief, aspirational page led by a headline on technology. Uses first-person plural 'We believe' for innovation and 'We are investing' for diversity, with a specific dollar figure and deadline. Diversity is the only concrete commitment; the ranking links and recruiting prompt are site chrome. No customers, employees or governance values appear.
